issues.description: The problem statement and the template expect a Developer instance method named `swiftExperienceDescription()`, but the solution implementation defines this method under a different name (`getExperienceDescription()`). Additionally, the solution's Client still calls `swiftExperienceDescription()`. This naming mismatch across artifacts makes it unclear which method students should implement and may cause compilation/runtime confusion when comparing template, requirements, and the provided solution.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the identifier consistent across all artifacts. Rename the solution method `getExperienceDescription()` to `swiftExperienceDescription()` (and update internal calls in Developer.init to call `swiftExperienceDescription()`), or alternatively rename the declarations/calls in the problem/template to match `getExperienceDescription()`. Prefer aligning the solution with the problem/template (i.e., use `swiftExperienceDescription()`) so students can clearly map the requirement to the implementation.
